title: US reshuffles Canada tariffs; deal said to be soon
summary: The US lifted 50% tariffs on 22 Canadian categories and added 100 new ones, about $2.5B of goods in each case. Trump said a tariff deal is coming soon and Hassett said talks are gathering steam; a deal would help GM, Ford and Stellantis.
connection_notes: The tariff-list changes are in place. The deal itself is the separate developing item. Oct 27 digest: talks are on easing Section 232 tariffs, possibly before Nov 3, with Canadian steel and auto tariffs rising to 50% on Jan 1, 2027 if there is no deal. Ford reports Oct 28.

title: Texas AG sues OpenAI and Altman over safety
summary: Texas AG Paxton sued OpenAI and Sam Altman over ChatGPT safety claims, seeking age limits and court-approved safety reviews before launches. The case is an overhang for Microsoft and Oracle.
connection_notes: Overhang for Microsoft and Oracle, both tied to OpenAI.

title: Moderna down ~8-9% premarket on melanoma data
summary: Moderna fell about 8-9% premarket after dropping more than 18% Thursday and Friday. The Phase 3 personalized melanoma vaccine with Merck, plus Keytruda, cut recurrence or death by 42%, versus 49% in Phase 2b, and the reaction was sell-the-news.
connection_notes: Premarket follow-through after the Thursday-Friday drop of more than 18%.

title: FDA approves at-home Skyrizi induction in Crohn's
summary: The FDA approved AbbVie's subcutaneous Skyrizi for induction in Crohn's disease, so patients can start treatment at home.

title: FDA approves Awiqli for children
summary: The FDA approved Novo Nordisk's once-weekly insulin Awiqli for pediatric use.
connection_notes: Diabetes franchise; Lilly reports Oct 29.

title: EQT to buy Range in ~$12.8B all-stock deal
summary: EQT is buying Range Resources all-stock at 0.987 EQT shares per RRC share, about $12.8B of equity, creating the largest US gas producer at more than $50B. RRC rose 15% and EQT fell 4%, with a close targeted for Q1 2027.
connection_notes: Announced deal with today's stock moves. Close is targeted for Q1 2027. Exxon reports Oct 30.

title: Surgery Partners +21% on take-private talks
summary: Surgery Partners rose 21% on an FT report that Bon Secours Mercy Health is in late-stage talks to take it private for about $6B including debt, about $20 a share, with Bain keeping about 40%.
connection_notes: Late-stage talks, not a signed deal. The stated price is the reported takeout price.

title: FICO -4.5% after Wells Fargo downgrade
summary: FICO fell 4.5% after Wells Fargo downgraded it to Equal Weight with a $735 target. A $10 bundled mortgage-score price is raising worries about pricing power versus VantageScore.

title: UBS upgrades Ross Stores, target $315
summary: UBS upgraded Ross Stores with a $315 target.

title: TD Cowen upgrades Booz Allen, target $95
summary: TD Cowen upgraded Booz Allen with a $95 target.

title: Morgan Stanley cuts XYZ target to $80
summary: Morgan Stanley cut its XYZ target to $80.

title: Floor & Decor target cut to $52
summary: Floor & Decor's target was cut to $52.

title: Spotify downgraded
summary: Spotify was downgraded.
connection_notes: Follows the Oct 22 post-earnings bounce.

title: Meta ATM of up to $60B, no earlier than Q1 2027
summary: Meta's at-the-market sale of up to $60B of non-voting Class C shares is planned no earlier than Q1 2027.
key_number: Up to $60B ATM; no earlier than Q1 2027
connection_notes: Second piece of the raise. Oct 26 digest described a $60B ATM expected in Q1 2027 once Class C shares trade. Oct 27 digest: up to $60B of non-voting Class C, no earlier than Q1 2027. Class C shares are set to take effect Jan 19, 2027.

title: Instacart explores a sale, possible $16-17B
summary: Instacart is exploring a sale and is in early talks with Uber and DoorDash, at a possible value of $16-17B, according to The Information.

title: Legendary revives takeover talks
summary: Legendary revived takeover talks and submitted an offer.

title: Veritas explores Chromalloy sale above $10B
summary: Veritas is exploring a sale of Chromalloy for more than $10B, a read-through for the aerospace aftermarket.
connection_notes: Aerospace aftermarket read-through to Boeing.

title: Oracle weighs off-books vehicle to lease chips
summary: Oracle is weighing an investor-funded vehicle that would buy chips and lease them back, keeping the debt off its books.
connection_notes: Would sit beside the $288B of leases not yet started and the OpenAI contract.

title: Nvidia seeks >$500B of outside AI capital
summary: Nvidia has preliminary agreements with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman and KKR targeting more than $500B of outside capital for AI infrastructure.
connection_notes: Preliminary LP agreements beside the backstops already extended to neoclouds.

title: Google and Constellation nuclear deals
summary: Alphabet and Constellation Energy have a 20-year deal for 890 MW of new nuclear and a 15-year deal for 2.7 GW, supporting $4.3B of upgrades.
connection_notes: Nuclear power for Google, alongside other hyperscaler power contracts.

title: Vistra 207 MW data-center deal starts Q3 2027
summary: Vistra has a 20-year, 207 MW deal with New Era Energy & Digital starting in Q3 2027. Its data-center deals total about 4.2 GW.
key_number: 207 MW from Q3 2027; ~4.2 GW of deals
connection_notes: Data-center power contract. Reported Oct 26, with the start dated to Q3 2027.

title: US-Canada Section 232 deal still in talks
summary: Reuters says the US and Canada are working on a deal to ease Section 232 tariffs, up to 50% on steel and 25% on autos, which matters for GM, Ford, Stellantis and steelmakers. A Canadian source says a deal is possible before the Nov 3 midterms, US sources want more concessions, and Trump plans to raise Canadian steel and auto tariffs to 50% on Jan 1, 2027 otherwise.
key_number: Possible before Nov 3; else 50% on Jan 1, 2027
connection_notes: Oct 26 digest: a deal was reportedly close with no timeline, Trump said it was coming soon, and Hassett said talks were gathering steam. Oct 27 digest adds the Section 232 terms, the midterm window, and the Jan 1, 2027 fallback. The tariff-list reshuffle is the linked happened item. Ford reports Oct 28. Steelmakers, including Nucor, are the other read-through.

title: Cellectar Waldenstrom filing targeted for H1 2027
summary: Cellectar reported an 87.5% response rate in a Phase 2b Waldenstrom study. Phase 3 and an accelerated-approval filing are targeted for H1 2027.
connection_notes: H1 2027 is the stated window, so the date is not pinned to a day.

title: MacroGenics lorigerlimab update targeted for H1 2027
summary: MacroGenics reported a 25% response rate in an interim Phase 2 of lorigerlimab in gynecologic cancer, with an update targeted for H1 2027.
connection_notes: H1 2027 is the stated window, so the date is not pinned to a day.

title: Tehran talks agree to keep going
summary: Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials held talks in Tehran and agreed to keep talking. The Oct 26 note also had a Qatari delegation there to avert renewed fighting.
connection_notes: Diplomatic track opposite a strike. Oct 26 digest had Qatari, Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish delegations in Tehran. Oct 27 digest: Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials agreed to keep talking. Trump is near a decision on a deal or more strikes. Oil, airlines and defense are the market read-through.

title: Cadence, Nucor and Whirlpool reported after the close
summary: Cadence, Nucor and Whirlpool reported after the close on Oct 26, with the figures on the linked items. Welltower was also on the Oct 26 slate, and the Oct 27 digest did not include its results.
connection_notes: Nucor is also in the Mexico steel-tariff talks and the US-Canada Section 232 talks. Welltower was on the Oct 26 after-close slate. Oct 27 digest had results for Cadence, Nucor and Whirlpool only.

title: GE Vernova reports before the open
summary: GE Vernova reports before the open on Oct 28.
connection_notes: Same week as the Fed, after the Oct 22 power selloff.

title: Oracle Investor Day
summary: Oracle holds its Investor Day on Oct 28, the bigger test for its debt-funded buildout after it launched 25 new AI agent apps for Fusion Cloud at Oracle AI World.
connection_notes: First listed Oct 26. Oct 27 digest: Investor Day is the bigger test of the debt-funded buildout. The 25 new Fusion Cloud agent apps are the linked launch.

title: Bank of Japan decision
summary: The Bank of Japan decides on Oct 30.
connection_notes: Same week as the Fed. First listed Oct 26. Oct 27 digest reconfirmed the Bank of Japan decision on Friday, Oct 30.

title: FDA decision: Summit ivonescimab
summary: The FDA decision date for Summit Therapeutics' ivonescimab is Saturday, Nov 14.
connection_notes: Cancer antibody decision, tied to the broader oncology landscape. First listed Oct 26. Oct 27 digest reconfirmed the Nov 14 date.

title: Monday close: S&P 7,676.77, led by chips
summary: Monday's close was led by chips after Anthropic's IPO filing. The S&P rose 0.7% to 7,676.77, the Nasdaq rose 0.82% to 26,169.38 and the Dow rose 0.28% to 52,361.58.
connection_notes: Chip bid followed Anthropic's S-1. Tuesday morning futures are the next session.

title: Futures up for a second day
summary: Around 7:30-8 AM, S&P futures were up 0.2% to 0.3%, Nasdaq 100 futures were up 0.3% to 0.5% and Dow futures were up 0.2% to 0.25%.
key_number: S&P fut. +0.2% to +0.3%; Nasdaq 100 fut. +0.3% to +0.5%
connection_notes: Second morning of modest gains, after Monday's chip-led close, with the Fed meeting starting the same day.

title: Oil near six-month highs; Brent about $116
summary: As of about 5 AM, Brent was about $116.26, up 0.4%, and WTI about $102.16, still near six-month highs, with Hormuz flows about 60% of normal and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia continuing. Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials agreed in Tehran to keep talking, Trump said he is near a decision on a deal with Iran or more strikes, and the tape matters for Exxon, Chevron, airlines and inflation ahead of the Fed.
connection_notes: Follows the Oct 26 pullback. JetBlue's fuel comment, energy earnings, Boeing, Lockheed and the Fed are the read-through.

title: Israel votes
summary: Israel holds its election on Oct 27, with no result in the note. Oil and defense stay headline-driven while Trump weighs an Iran deal against more strikes.
connection_notes: Same-day geopolitical headline as the oil tape and the Iran decision.

title: China AI and chip indexes sell off; Kospi up 3.1%
summary: The Kospi rose 3.1% to 5,638 and the Nikkei rose 1.7% to 63,268. China was the outlier: Shanghai fell 1.3% to a 14-month low, STAR50 fell 4.8%, the CSI Semiconductor index fell 5.8% and the CSI AI index fell nearly 4%, the Hang Seng fell 0.7% and HS Tech fell 1.5%, and the AI and chip trade is unwinding, with Alibaba, Baidu and Tencent ADRs exposed.
connection_notes: The unwind sits next to the PBOC liquidity facility and the earlier China bear-market print.

title: PBOC opens an emergency liquidity facility
summary: China's central bank set up an emergency liquidity swap facility for non-bank financial firms facing large redemptions, a sign of stress in China markets.
connection_notes: Policy response alongside the China AI and chip selloff.

title: Anthropic files its S-1; ticker ANT
summary: Anthropic filed its S-1 on Monday for Nasdaq ticker ANT, with Goldman and Morgan Stanley leading: H1 2026 revenue was $16.29B versus $1.16B a year ago, the net loss was $80.7B mostly from a $72.4B convertible-note charge, the operating loss was $693M, adjusted operating income was $1.62B, and operating cash flow was $3.9B. Q2 compute spend was $5.6B against $11.6B of revenue, and reported compute commitments are about $657B, including up to $120.5B to SpaceX for Nvidia GPUs, $114.5B or more to Google, $110B to Amazon and $44.9B to Microsoft.
connection_notes: The listing is still ahead, expected before Thanksgiving and reported for the week of Nov 16. The filing is the read-through for the Broadcom chip SPV, the DA Davidson upgrade, SpaceX GPU commitments, and Monday's chip-led close.

title: Banks set up a $63B Broadcom-Anthropic chip SPV
summary: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley set up a $63B vehicle to buy Broadcom custom AI chips and networking gear and lease them to Anthropic, with deliveries from 2027. Broadcom gives residual-value support equal to the senior debt, so it carries some risk if chip values fall, and how rating agencies treat that support is still open.
connection_notes: Separate from the Oct 22 up-to-$42B Broadcom loan to Anthropic. Tied to the S-1, the DA Davidson upgrade and SpaceX's GPU commitments. Deliveries and the rating-agency question are still ahead.

title: DA Davidson upgrades Broadcom to Buy, target $400
summary: DA Davidson upgraded Broadcom to Buy and raised its target to $400 from $350.
connection_notes: Same-day read on the Anthropic chip SPV and the S-1 compute commitments, including SpaceX GPUs.

title: Nvidia to invest $3B in Meta's offering
summary: Nvidia is investing $3B in Meta's stock offering. Meta will expand its use of Vera Rubin and the Vera CPU and deepen work on its Muse AI agent, another round of circular AI financing that dilutes Meta.
connection_notes: The investment is part of Meta's enlarged raise. Vera Rubin is also the Nvidia platform in the Samsung and SK hynix HBM4 plan.

title: Celestica jumps 15% to 17% on an AI hardware beat
summary: Celestica rose 15% to 17% premarket after Q3 revenue grew 83% to $5.83B and adjusted EPS came in at $3.30 versus about $2.96 to $2.99 expected. It raised the 2026 revenue target to $21B, guided 2027 to $40B of revenue and $21.50 of EPS against a consensus near $35.7B, cut the free-cash-flow forecast to $460M from $600M, said 2028 customer demand should be meaningfully higher than 2027, and put 2027 capex at $1.5B to $2B.
connection_notes: Bullish for the AI hardware supply chain, alongside the Cadence and Amkor prints.

title: Cadence beats; 2026 growth guide raised to 21%
summary: Cadence rose 2.4% to 2.6% after hours on adjusted EPS of $2.11 versus $2.04 and revenue of $1.63B, up 22%, with a record $8.2B backlog. It raised the 2026 revenue-growth guide to 21%, added another $2.5B to the buyback, and introduced AI design models built with Nvidia.
connection_notes: After-close report from the Oct 26 slate. The new design models were built with Nvidia.

title: Amkor rises 3.5% premarket despite a miss
summary: Amkor rose 3.5% premarket despite EPS of $0.76 and revenue of $1.99B versus about $2.04B expected. The fourth-quarter guide is $1.9B to $2.0B, capex was cut to about $2.5B, and AI packaging demand is holding up.
connection_notes: AI packaging demand is the same thread as Nvidia's $3B packaging deal with Amkor.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra at $1 and $5
summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens, 50% cheaper than prior models. Cheaper tokens can help adoption and pressure OpenAI's revenue per token, which matters for Oracle, Microsoft and CoreWeave.
connection_notes: Sits on the OpenAI revenue debate and on Oracle's Investor Day, Microsoft's earnings and the neocloud selloff.

title: Intel agrees to buy Classiq for about $2.3B
summary: Intel agreed to buy Israeli quantum-software firm Classiq for about $2.3B in cash and stock, its first major deal in years, ahead of Thursday's earnings. The deal still needs regulatory clearance.
connection_notes: Announced ahead of Thursday's earnings. Clearance is still required. Monday's move was the New Street upgrade, not this deal.

title: New Street upgrades Intel; shares up 6%
summary: On Monday Intel rose 6% to about $91.82 after New Street upgraded the stock to Buy with a $125 target.
connection_notes: Monday's move, ahead of Thursday earnings and separate from the Classiq agreement.

title: Oracle launches 25 AI agent apps for Fusion Cloud
summary: Oracle launched 25 new AI agent apps for Fusion Cloud at Oracle AI World.
connection_notes: The product launch ahead of Wednesday's Investor Day, which is the bigger test of the debt-funded buildout.

title: CoreWeave adds Denmark capacity and an AI backbone
summary: CoreWeave announced new capacity in Denmark and a global AI network backbone.
connection_notes: Announced while CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN are each down more than 35% in October.

title: Samsung and SK hynix target HBM4 for Vera Rubin in Q2 2027
summary: Samsung and SK hynix reportedly plan 8-layer HBM4 mass production and delivery to Nvidia in the second quarter of 2027. Nvidia reportedly trimmed some Vera Rubin memory and NVLink specs, a sign that HBM supply is tight.
connection_notes: Dated to Q2 2027 because only the quarter was given. The Vera Rubin trim was attributed to Expreview. Meta's plan to use more Vera Rubin, and SK hynix's Wednesday return vote, are the linked items.

title: SK hynix rises more than 4%
summary: SK hynix rose more than 4% as it and Samsung lined up HBM4 for Nvidia and the board prepared a shareholder-return vote with earnings.
connection_notes: No US ticker was stated. The move sits with the HBM4 plan and Wednesday's earnings and return vote.

title: SK hynix earnings and shareholder-return vote
summary: SK hynix reports on Oct 28, and the board is set to review a shareholder-return package of 50 trillion to 60 trillion won the same day.
connection_notes: Wednesday's vote is the near-term event. The HBM4 production target is Q2 2027.

title: FDA expands Pfizer's Talzenna plus Xtandi
summary: The FDA expanded Talzenna plus Xtandi to HRR-mutated metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer. In the Phase 3 TALAPRO-3 trial of 599 patients, the combination cut the risk of progression or death by 52%, and earlier-line use widens the market.
connection_notes: Label expansion, set against the broader oncology sales landscape.

title: Genmab jumps as much as 13% on petosemtamab data
summary: Genmab jumped as much as 13% on Monday after petosemtamab plus chemo shrank tumors in 75% of first-line advanced colorectal cancer patients and 67% of second-line patients in a mid-stage ESMO trial. Phase 3 trials in both lines are underway, and a Phase 1/2 combo with Incyte's KRAS G12D drug is planned.
connection_notes: Monday's move. Phase 3 is underway and the Incyte combo is still planned. The data were at ESMO.

title: PayPal revenue misses; profit outlook raised
summary: PayPal fell 1%. Revenue was $8.58B versus $8.71B expected, EPS beat, and the full-year profit outlook was raised.

title: UPS beats and lifts its revenue guide to about $92.6B
summary: UPS rose 1.6% on adjusted EPS of $1.69 versus $1.63 and revenue of $22.9B. The full-year revenue guide rose to about $92.6B from $91.2B.
connection_notes: Had been listed with Boeing for Oct 27. Results were in by the Oct 27 morning digest.

title: Coca-Cola beats and lifts the 2026 outlook again
summary: Coca-Cola rose 0.3% on revenue of $13.4B and adjusted EPS of $0.91, both beats. It raised the 2026 outlook for a third straight quarter, with comparable EPS growth of at least 11%.
key_number: Rev $13.4B; adj EPS $0.91; EPS growth at least 11%

title: Corning EPS $0.91 on revenue of $5.08B
summary: Corning rose 3% on EPS of $0.91 versus $0.88 and revenue of $5.08B.

title: Royal Caribbean beats and raises 2026 guidance
summary: Royal Caribbean rose 4.4% on adjusted EPS of $6.57 versus $6.38 and raised its 2026 guidance.

title: SoFi posts record revenue and raises 2026 guidance
summary: SoFi reported record adjusted net revenue of $1.4B, up 44%, net income of $241M and adjusted EPS of $0.18, raised its 2026 guidance, and grew members 35% to 15.8 million. The stock was down about 45% year to date into the print.

title: JetBlue rises 8% to 11% even with higher fuel
summary: JetBlue rose 8% to 11%. It sees fourth-quarter margin expansion even with fuel about 85% higher than a year ago.
connection_notes: Fuel is the airline read-through from the Iran and oil tape.

title: Whirlpool loss; 2026 revenue guide cut to $14.5B
summary: Whirlpool fell 7% to 8.5% on an adjusted loss of $0.21 versus a $0.80 profit expected, and revenue of $3.68B. It cut the 2026 revenue guide to $14.5B and now expects a $1.30 loss per share, with housing weakness the backdrop.
connection_notes: After-close report from the Oct 26 slate. Housing weakness is the same backdrop as the Owens Corning target cut.

title: HSBC falls more than 6% on a revenue miss
summary: HSBC fell more than 6%. Third-quarter pretax profit rose 32% to $9.6B, revenue of $18.6B missed $18.93B, and it announced a new $1B buyback.

title: Nucor in line; fourth quarter in line to modestly above
summary: Nucor fell 0.5% after hours. EPS was $5.80 and sales were $11.25B, in line, and the fourth quarter was guided in line to modestly above the third quarter.
connection_notes: After-hours report from the Oct 26 slate. Nucor is a steel name in the Mexico tariff talks and the US-Canada Section 232 talks.

title: Rosenblatt raises Palantir target to $260
summary: Rosenblatt raised its Palantir target to $260 from $225 and kept a Buy rating, ahead of Nov 2 earnings.
connection_notes: Ahead of the Nov 2 report. LSEG's growth rates are on the earnings item.

title: MercadoLibre upgraded to Buy, target $2,050
summary: MercadoLibre was upgraded to Buy with a $2,050 target.

title: MACOM raised to Outperform, target $300
summary: MACOM was raised to Outperform with a $300 target.

title: Ferguson upgraded to Buy, target $288
summary: Ferguson was upgraded to Buy with a $288 target.

title: Badger Meter upgraded to Buy, target $170
summary: Badger Meter was upgraded to Buy with a $170 target.

title: BofA cuts Owens Corning target to $145
summary: Bank of America cut its Owens Corning target to $145 on weak shingle demand.
connection_notes: Weak shingle demand is the housing thread that also showed up in Whirlpool's guide cut.

title: Vertiv closes the UtilityInnovation Group deal
summary: Vertiv closed its purchase of UtilityInnovation Group for about $1.45B upfront plus an earn-out of up to $1.15B. The deal adds on-site power and microgrid controls for power-limited AI data centers.
connection_notes: Closed deal for AI data-center power. Vertiv was also on an earlier Oct 28 earnings slate. Vistra's unsigned co-location talks are the neighboring power story.

title: Jio Platforms lists in India
summary: Jio Platforms, part of Reliance, lists in India on Oct 28. The grey market implies about a 22% pop over the 1,119 rupee issue price, and it is India's largest IPO by applications.
connection_notes: The Oct 22 item is the offering filling in two hours. This is the listing.

title: Lockheed F-35 framework awaits Congress
summary: Lockheed has a 10-year Pentagon framework for at least 850 F-35s at 156 a year, pending Congress approval.
connection_notes: Oct 22 earnings already carried a preliminary 850 F-35 figure. This is the 10-year framework, still pending Congress, with Iran headlines in the background.

title: Vistra in talks on data-center power
summary: Vistra is in talks on data-center co-location and on new gas or nuclear capacity. Nothing is signed.
connection_notes: Unsigned talks, separate from the 207 MW New Era contract that starts in the third quarter of 2027. Vertiv's closed microgrid deal is the neighboring AI-power transaction.

title: Visa reports after the close
summary: Visa reports after the close on Oct 27. The estimate is about $3.44 of EPS and about $12.09B of revenue.
connection_notes: Same after-close window as Robinhood. The Fireblocks talks are a separate Visa item.

title: Robinhood reports after the close, call at 5 PM
summary: Robinhood reports after the close on Oct 27, with the call at 5 PM. The estimate is about $0.56 of EPS and about $1.44B of revenue.

connection_notes: Same after-close window as Visa.
